v.q: What does "build once, deploy everywhere" mean?
o: The same image runs in every environment
v.w: Only the configuration differs between environments.

v.q: Which command gives reproducible installs in CI?
v.w: It fails if the lockfile is out of date.

o: Dev tools stay out of the runtime image
It removes the need for a lockfile
v.w: The final stage copies only dist and prod dependencies.

v.q: Why copy package.json and the lockfile before the source?
v.w: Source edits do not reinstall dependencies.

v.q: Why prefer CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"] to npm start?
v.w: npm as PID 1 does not forward signals.

v.q: What follows SIGTERM if the app ignores it?

o: A secret manager, injected at start
v.w: Rotate them without rebuilding the image.

v.q: What should a service do with invalid config?
o: Start and fail on first request
v.w: A crashing pod stops the rollout.

v.q: What should the liveness probe check?
v.w: A dependency check could restart every pod.

v.q: What does a failing readiness probe cause?
Which setting avoids losing capacity in a rolling update?
v.w: Start a new pod before stopping an old one.

v.q: How should a column be removed during a rolling release?
v.w: Old and new code run at the same time.

v.q: How many CPUs does a Node pod usually need?
v.w: Scale out with more pods instead.

v.q: How should the V8 heap limit relate to the memory limit?
v.w: Buffers and native memory live outside the heap.

v.q: What fixes sporadic 502 errors after idle periods?
Why set trust proxy in Express?
v.w: Trust only the known number of hops.
